name: signal-dash
description: Stock mentions in official posts — dashboard inside VS Code

signalDash.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run the backend (needs fastapi, uvicorn, etc. installed). When left at the default, backend/.venv is used automatically if it exists.

signalDash.port.description: Port the FastAPI backend listens on.

signalDash.backendPath.description: Absolute path to the backend/ directory. Leave empty to auto-detect (workspace folder containing backend/app.py, else the folder next to this extension).

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-frontend.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
